<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 4:24">Targ. Y. Ex. IV, 24</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Gittin 75a:10">Gitt. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>לא כפליה לתְנָאֵיה</he> he did not double his stipulation, did not stipulate what is to take place in the case of fulfillment of his condition, and what in the case of non-fulfillment; a. e.—Pl. <he>תְּנָאַיָּיא</he>, <he>תְּנָאֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 19b:7">Keth. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>זילו קיימו תְּנָאיְיכוּ וכ׳</he> go and fulfill your conditions, and then go to law. Gitt. l. c. <he>כל ת׳ היכא גמרינן להו</he> whence do we derive all the rules about stipulations; a. e.
